purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: business chat; vocabulary (一生懸命/がんばっ/取り組ん/経費/役員) in natural home.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: このプロジェクト、よく取り組んだね。
lines.en: You worked hard on this project.
lines.style: warm boss voice, soft warm composed approving clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: チームで、一生懸命やりました。
lines.en: We gave it our all as a team.
lines.style: earnest young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 経費は、抑えられたかね?
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 経費を抑えつつ、取り組みました。
lines.en: We worked on it while controlling expenses.
lines.style: reliable young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 役員会でも、評価が高かったよ。
lines.en: It was rated highly at the board too.
lines.style: composed boss voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: I'm grateful to the board members.
lines.style: humble young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 一生懸命さが、伝わったんだな。
lines.style: warm boss voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 次も、一生懸命取り組みます。
lines.en: I'll give my all on the next one too.
lines.style: resolved young manager voice, soft warm closing throughout
